mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qna_notification_log (qna_id, answerer_id, recipient_id, channel, status) VALUES (#{qnaId}, #{answererId}, #{recipientId}, #{channel}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, qna_id, answerer_id, recipient_id, channel, status, retry_count, last_error, sent_at, created_at FROM qna_notification_log WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND retry_count < 3 ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 100
